sources.definition: Weighted survey births in the two years preceding the survey; not national birth totals

limitations: Survey weighted counts are sampling denominators, not national birth totals; never weight countries using these counts.
Wealth quintiles rank assets within each country at survey time; they are not global income quintiles and newborn shares are not necessarily 20% each.
Age groups are conservatively treated as respondent age at survey, not confirmed age at delivery. Using these groups for birth age is a proxy.
Wealth, residence and maternal-age tables are separate marginals/conditionals. Combining them requires an explicit conditional-independence model.
Birth order counts prior births, not currently living or co-resident siblings; 5+ is right-censored and must remain 4+ prior births.
Father age and occupations are not measured by these indicators.
Missing countries/years require a disclosed cross-country or temporal proxy; do not label such draws observed for the target.
Missing and suppressed groups are omitted; normalize only within complete or disclosed available categories.

Some surveys interview ever-married women only or exclude geographic areas; inspect surveyUniverseWomen and surveyFootnotes. Observed refers to the published survey estimate, not universal population coverage.
Published group count sums may differ from the total due to missing categories and rounding; use the relevant category count sum as denominator and disclose incomplete coverage.
